The 2025 Senior Bowl offered an opportunity for draft-eligible players to showcase their talents in front of ... However, among the top performers of the overall camp was wide receiver** Tez Johnson **. Johnson entered the camp as one of the nation's best receivers of the past two seasons, setting program records as the Ducks went a combined 25-3 with him on the roster. ... 2025 NFL Draft risers] . After being seen as a late day three pick, Sikkema moved Johnson up to a priority day ... Big Board, sixth amongst draft-eligible Ducks. "How high could PFF's expectations really be for a wide receiver who is just 5-foot-9, 156 pounds?" wrote Sikkema. "I ... Johnson was electric in his first season with the Ducks, catching 86 passes for 1,182 yards and 10 touchdowns. Johnson broke the program's single-season reception record, beating out teammate** Troy Franklin ,**who set the record a game prior in the Pac-12 Championship Game. After announcing his return for his final season, Johnson was Oregon's No. 1 receiver forGabriel, and despite missing two games, he still finished the 2024 season with 83 receptions for 898 yards and 10 touchdowns.
